software.name: CodeBase v1.5
software.description: CodeBase v1.5 is a Python GUI tool built with Tkinter for repository analysis. It scans text files (e.g., .py, .txt) in a selected folder, displaying contents in a Content Preview tab, a tree-based Folder Structure, and a customizable Base Prompt. Features include clipboard copying, token counting, hover tooltips, and file inclusion/exclusion settings. Users can save/load templates, prepend prompts, and toggle structure icons. With a dark theme, recent folder tracking, and clear-all options, it boosts productivity for developers. Set for MIT License release in 2025.
